title: A monic divisor of a base-field polynomial has algebraic coefficients
statement: Let $K/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension], let $P\in k[T]$ and $Q\in K[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] be monic, meaning their leading coefficients are $1$. Write $P_K$ for the coefficientwise image of $P$ under $k\to K$ [def-weil-coefficientwise-ring-hom-map]. If $Q$ divides $P_K$ in $K[T]$, then every coefficient of $Q$ is algebraic over $k$ [def-weil-algebraic-element].

source.place: Algebra, Tag 00H6 (lemma-polynomials-divide), clause (1), specialized to the subfield k of K
